name: screen rendering parity

test_list.description: A broad transcript hit region remains non-decorative; only action affordances receive hover styles.
Tool/latest/footer/completion hover changes only the exact intended foreground or bounded background.
Copy selection blends 30 percent source foreground over the existing background, uses neutral whitespace tint, ANSI index 237 and bold without color.
Question choice, tabs, notes and submit have typed targets; the main composer is absent and question hints remain pinned.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Borrowed application view, composer and optional questionnaire draft.

output_description: Painted styled cells, typed hit targets, geometry and source mappings.
